entities.name: Vincent-Marie Viénot, Count of Vaublanc
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Vincent-Marie Viénot de Vaublanc, 1st baron Viénot de Vaublanc and of the Empire, known as the Count de Vaublanc, was a French royalist politician, official, writer and artist. He was a deputy for the Seine-et-Marne department in the French Legislative Assembly, served as president of the same body, and from 26 September 1815 to 7 May 1816, he was Minister of the Interior.
